_comment: How go card online worked when this project was written: the parts fetch_history.py depends on. A structural fingerprint only (no copied pages, no personal data). fetch_history.py checks the live site against it on every run, and `fetch_history.py --check-site` reports any differences. If Translink changes the site, update the code and this file together.

export.too_long_range: a CSV with only the header row (seen 2026-10-24; earlier the body was empty). Never an error page.
export.time_format: 17:20 PM (24-hour clock with a redundant AM/PM suffix)

row_types.trip: From/To are stop names, Fare is set
row_types.auto_top_up: From = 'Auto top up(<stop>)', amount in Credit
row_types.driver_top_up: From = 'Top Up( <depot> )', amount in Credit; To/Fare make it a trip too
row_types.failed_touch_off: To = 'Failed to touch Off', arrival time 'Unknown'; may have no time or stop

protection: Imperva/Incapsula CDN; plain HTTPS requests with a browser User-Agent work, no captcha
